articles.title: ‘Could sell 3,000 more EVs a month’ if supply constraints ease: Mahindra
articles.titleEn: ‘Could sell 3,000 more EVs a month’ if supply constraints ease: Mahindra
articles.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra reported strong demand for its electric vehicles, which may reach 10,000 to 11,000 units monthly. Current production capacity for electric SUVs is around 8,000 units, which is expected to increase to 12,000 this financial year. The rise in petrol and diesel prices, along with improved charging infrastructure, is encouraging more customers to opt for electric vehicles.

articles.title: US CPI inflation rises as Iran war drives up fuel prices: How higher petrol and diesel costs could hit American households
articles.titleEn: US CPI inflation rises as Iran war drives up fuel prices: How higher petrol and diesel costs could hit American households
articles.summary: American households are facing increased inflation and rising fuel prices just weeks before the midterm elections. Consumer prices rose unexpectedly in September, driven primarily by a significant rise in gasoline costs. The conflict involving the United States and Iran has contributed to these economic pressures, particularly affecting energy availability. As a result, businesses may need to increase prices on goods and services to offset higher operational costs.
